overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today, driven mainly by low overnight humidity (24%) and warm afternoon temps near 63°, even as weekend rain moves in.**
- Week-ahead trend stays flat: Moderate danger through Oct 15, with ERC near 60–66% and BI in the high-50s to upper-60s all week.
- Key driver: humidity rebounds to 48–57% starting Saturday as modest rain (up to 0.06") and cooler highs (low-to-mid 50s, dropping to 43° by the 15th) move through.
- Only 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds is tripped today (overnight RH), no Red Flag Warning is in effect, and NWS reports no active alerts for the area.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions in the BLM Gunnison Field Office were lifted September 18, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect; Ouray County similarly rescinded all fire restrictions for unincorporated areas effective September 18.
- No new large fires are reported in or near these counties in today's national situation report; expect scattered showers and thunderstorms Saturday (60% chance) to further ease danger.
